scope: functional game mechanics from cataloged Paizo core rulebooks

public_decisions.PUBLIC_AS_IS: A complete, terse functional rule may be retained verbatim only when it contains no reserved setting material, expressive example or narrative prose, trademark-only branding, private data, or local provenance.
public_decisions.MIXED_NEEDS_EXTRACTION: Rewrite a mixed section as a concise, faithful statement of only the operational rules facts. Do not preserve expressive wording, examples, lore, characters, places, art captions, or other reserved material.

nonpublic_decisions.EXCLUDE: Use for Foundry duplicates, parser fragments, navigation, nonfunctional prose, reserved material, or sections whose mechanic is not usable without excluded context.
nonpublic_decisions.UNCERTAIN: Use whenever the functional-mechanics or licensing boundary cannot be made confidently safe. Uncertain text is never exported.

evidence.foundry: Local Foundry data may prove duplication or corroborate an already classified mechanic, but its presence is not by itself redistribution authority.
evidence.aon: Archives of Nethys is optional existence and provenance corroboration only. Absence proves nothing, and AON text must never be copied.

required_review: Every decision requires a separately claimed review. Public text is exported only after APPROVE; EXCLUDE or UNCERTAIN is resolved only after the reviewer confirms the nonpublication decision.
release_gate: This review policy is an engineering control, not legal advice. Public artifacts still require the repository's distribution audit and maintainer-approved notices.
